_format: One entry per advisor ruling on a disputed hit: ONE advisory incident and ONE package (REQ-SUP-001-AC10; advisor 0179). ids: every advisory id of the dispute, exactly. authoritative: the source the advisor ruled correct for this incident; ranges: that source's affected ranges, verbatim. A version outside the ranges passes; a version inside them is a hit. modified: each id's last-modified time when the ruling was made (GitHub's for a GHSA id, OSV's otherwise); the entry lapses the moment any changes. Same format as the ops repo's docs/supply-chain-exceptions.json.

exceptions.ruling: false positive for 0.74.0: the Go-database entry GO-2026-4919 is open-ended from 0.69.4; the incident's GitHub advisory (and OSV's own copy of it) lists exactly 0.69.4
